chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a woman leading women in prayer, and he said: There is no problem with it.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A title of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.النِّسَاءَ: the women; those being led in congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman; the subject of the legal ruling
key_terms.تَؤُمُّ: leads in prayer; serves as the prayer leader
key_terms.سَأَلْتُ: I asked; indicates the direct inquiry to the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem; a formula indicating permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a woman to lead other women in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith states that it is permissible for a woman to lead other women in salat (prayer). It is a brief legal ruling from Imam Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام on congregational prayer among women.
